theorems.label: closest-string-balanced-kxk
theorems.statement: Under the k × k Clique Hypothesis, no deterministic Closest String algorithm runs in 2^(o(d log₂ d)) N^(O(1)) time on instances of common length d+1 with exactly 2d+3 distinct symbols occurring in the input strings.

title: A square-clique lower bound for Closest String with a balanced alphabet
